values: 一名擅长控制敌人的法师，同时自己还能对被控制的敌人造成额外的伤害。
A Mage who is skilled at controlling enemies and dealing extra damage to enemies under control effects.
比冰雪更无情的战场啊……
A battlefield more merciless than the frigid winter.
Even the candle's warmth can pierce through the winter cold.
请赐予我们永恒的宁静……
明亮而又温暖，这是胜利的感觉吗？
Is this what victory feels like?
寒风呼啸的夜晚，需要一点烛光吗？
The freezing wind howls tonight. Need a little candlelight?
下雪了，我已经没有能融化她的体温了。
I'm so tired... Hm? Snow? I don't even have a way to melt it...
热火和体温似乎一样的寒冷。
*Sigh* The candle light is as cold as the night time air.
是老鼠先生吗？在哪里，不在了，去睡吧。
Is someone calling me? Who is it? ...Go to sleep.
这样温暖的东西，我会永远保存……
Such warmth, I'll treasure it forever.
It's as if your warmth is woven into this gift...
I want to stay a bit longer...
It's hot and sweet. So yummy...
Please have a bowl of hot soup.
I want to watch the fireworks with my brother.
据说修道院的附近的雪原上生活着一只雪怪，有三只会发光的眼睛。卡列琳娜因为好奇而去寻找雪怪的期间，说自己目击到雪怪的人数剧烈攀升。

They say a monster with three glowing eyes lurks in the snowy fields near the monastery. Out of curiosity, Carolina went in search of the snow monster. During that time, sightings of the beast increased dramatically.
据大修道院中的修道者们说，后山的雪原上常常传来少女的哭泣声。
According to the acolytes of the temple, a girl's cries are often heard coming from the snowy plains surrounding the nearby mountain.
成为亡灵后的卡列琳娜再也感觉不到寒冷，但她偶尔会怀念生病时，父母敷在她头上的热毛巾的触感。
After returning as a Graveborn, Carolina is no longer bothered by the cold. Nevertheless, she sometimes recalls the warmth of her parents and the feeling of a hot towel on her head when she was sick.
卡列琳娜的姐姐们都陆续结婚离开了家中，只有哥哥一直陪伴着她，直到生命的尽头。
One by one, each of Carolina's older sisters married and left their home. Only her older brother remained by her side until his death.
“亲爱的卡列琳娜，有了这些蜡烛，你晚上就再也不会因为怕黑而哭泣了。爱你的姐姐们。”——来自卡列琳娜至今藏在烛台下的纸条。
"Dear Carolina, so long as you have these candles, your fear of the dark will never make you cry again. Love, your sisters."—From a note that Carolina keeps hidden under a candlestick holder.
卡列琳娜有时会称呼那个在墓室里保护自己的人偶为“哥哥”。
From time to time, Carolina refers to the golem that protected her in the tomb as her brother.
据修道院中的老者说，在大雪封山的天气，修道院附近会有幽灵出没。
The elders at the temple claim that spirits appear in the vicinity whenever a snowstorm engulfs the mountain.
卡列琳娜的家族与统领公国的大公家族有过姻亲，他们的祖辈时常往来。
Carolina's family was related by marriage to the ruling family of their principality. In the past, her ancestors shared even closer bonds.
卡列琳娜生前在修道院进修过，如果早已沉眠在地底的修士可以做出评判，他们会说，卡列琳娜是一位安静虔诚的贵族小姐。
In her previous life, Carolina had once studied in a temple. If the acolytes laid to rest beneath that temple could speak, they would attest to the quiet and pious nature of this young noblewoman.
修道院的大主教知道卡列琳娜的身份，会在下雪的日子偷偷保留几盏彻夜不熄的灯火，以给卡列琳娜引路。
The hierophant of the temple is well aware of Carolina's true identity. On snowy nights, he secretly keeps a number of lanterns lit to guide her way.
好香啊，茶壶先生泡的茶闻起来有股花的香味……
Smells great! Mister Teapot's tea always carries a floral scent...
It's hot and sweet. So yummy...
Please have a bowl of hot soup.
I want to watch the fireworks with my brother.
